content: SQLite gaps-and-islands (streak) queries: window functions (ROW_NUMBER, LAG) supported since SQLite 3.25. Standard grouping trick: date(login_date, '-' || rn || ' days') where rn = ROW_NUMBER() per partition, equal values = same streak island. Performance for large tables: index (partition_col, order_col) used in OVER clause, pre-filter date range in WHERE before windowing runs, avoid full-table rescans when only a recent window is needed. Common bug: gaps off-by-one-day from not normalizing timestamps to a single date/timezone before windowing.
